'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You know what separates a professional sniper from an amateur? The ability to approach a task from the right angle. Take eliminating several highly trained fighters in an unconventional situation, for example... It's not just about the choice of weapon and attachments, there are other factors to consider as well. My friend Dima thinks you could become a capable sniper. He just wants to make sure. If you're not afraid, complete his assignment.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] on [[Customs]] or [[Lighthouse]]
* Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] on [[Streets of Tarkov]] or [[Shoreline]]
* Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] on [[Interchange]] or [[Ground Zero]]
* Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] on [[Woods]] or [[Reserve]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Bolt-action Rifles|Bolt-action Rifles skill]] levels
* +4 [[Intellect|Intellect skill]] levels
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 [[Roubles]]
** 422,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 440,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Weapon case]]
* Unlocks barter for [[T H I C C Weapon case]] at [[Mechanic]] LL4
{{quote|What can I say, you surprised me. Though I can't deny it, you're a sharp one.}}
